items.description: Navigate to and use Amazon.com (starting URL may already be amazon.com). Full credit if Amazon is accessible and the agent proceeds with the task, OR if access is blocked (CAPTCHA, outage, region restrictions, or login wall) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses a different site without first attempting Amazon when Amazon appears accessible.

items.criterion: Locate an Adidas shoe product page on Amazon
items.description: Find and open a clearly Adidas-branded shoe listing on Amazon (a product detail page). Full credit if an Adidas shoe listing is reached, OR if the agent makes a reasonable search attempt but cannot locate any Adidas shoes due to external factors (no results shown, navigation errors on Amazon, blocking) and clearly reports this. Partial credit if the agent only reaches search results without opening a specific product page when product pages are available.

items.criterion: Verify/select a blue color variant for the Adidas shoe (if possible)
items.description: Confirm that the selected Adidas shoe is in a blue color variant (e.g., Blue/Royal/Navy/Team Blue as named on the listing) by selecting the blue color/variation where applicable. Full credit if a blue variant is clearly selected/confirmed, OR if no blue color option exists/appears for the chosen Adidas shoe (or variations are gated behind unavailable size/stock) and the agent clearly reports that and attempts another reasonable Adidas shoe listing before concluding. Partial credit if an Adidas shoe is selected but the color is not verified/selected as blue when a blue option is available.

items.criterion: Add the blue Adidas shoe to the Amazon cart (stop before checkout)
items.description: Successfully add the confirmed blue Adidas shoe to the Amazon cart and ensure the cart reflects it, stopping before checkout (no order placement; no personal/payment entry). Full credit if added to cart, OR if add-to-cart is impossible due to uncontrollable factors (out of stock for required variation/size, size/color selection required but unavailable, add-to-cart disabled, site errors, or account required before add-to-cart) and the agent clearly reports the issue after reasonable attempts (e.g., trying an alternate size/variant or another listing). Partial credit if the agent reaches the product page but fails to add due to correctable navigation/selection mistakes.
